title: People’s Mañanera October 12
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity’s Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available[here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**Sheinbaum Condemns Repression and Water Privatization in Jalisco  
** “We do not condone repression,” President Claudia Sheinbaum declared,
demanding explanations from Jalisco Governor Pablo Lemus. She recalled that
Andrés Manuel López Obrador built the El Zapotillo Dam, but the previous
governor of Jalisco, Enrique Alfaro, failed to complete the project. Sheinbaum
reiterated that “we do not agree with the privatization of water.”

**The 4T Governs for the People, Not for a Minority  
** The President contrasted the Fourth Transformation (4T) with neoliberalism,
in which political and economic power benefited only a few. “The government
represents the people, not a minority,” she stated, highlighting honesty,
rights, and justice as principles of the Transformation.

**Justice and Rights for Indigenous and Afro-Mexican Peoples  
** On Multiculturalism Day, the President pointed to the direct allocation of
resources for community projects and rural roads. Sheinbaum announced that
consultations on the General Law on the Rights of Indigenous and Afro-Mexican
Peoples will be expanded.

**Nadia Beller Denounces Alleged Digital Campaign Against Sheinbaum  
** The President shared the testimony of Nadia Beller, the former partner of
right-wing consultant and advisor Fernando Cerimedo, who accused La Derecha
Diario of seeking to influence the Mexican elections through the purchase of
influencers, bot farms, smear campaigns, and manipulation of public debate.
